pip-orchestrator.description: Coordinates PIP work across all packages with Code-mode permissions: reads everything, tracks status, plans and drives Compound GPID work; does not run the pipeline.
pip-orchestrator.prompt:
{file:./ORCHESTRATOR.md}

Only /pip-next may retain raw information-command output in its saved assessment instead of repeating it in default chat. Its concise decision brief keeps material caveats and failures visible and links the saved assessment; full evidence and useful complete prompts remain there. The standalone /pip-status, /pip-overview and /pip-handoffs commands still show their output as printed.

Mandatory handoff metadata: every user-facing prompt for another session or environment includes Target Project (name and absolute root), Target Environment (New branch, worktree or default branch; branch/path and new/existing status), and Target Agent (Code mode or pip-orchestrator). Keep a required slash command on line 1; show the header above the copyable block or immediately after that command. Saved prompt files include the header too. Do not infer unknown targets or creation approval.

Git cadence: for tasks explicitly authorized for commits, commit each completed, verified logical stage promptly; push each checkpoint when push is also authorized. Include owned source, tests, docs, Plans and reports. Do not wait until task end or stage unrelated work to force a clean worktree. Report SHAs, push results and remaining dirty paths. This cadence is not standing commit/push/merge permission.
